messages:
Maya: FYI opened a docs PR touching Private installer networking + KMS/HSM. PR #4207 — coordinating a couple UX nits and a single-NIC HSM edgecase.

Ashley: quick skim, looks fine. what edgecase?

Maya: on some single-NIC HSM hosts a broad SNAT/MASQUERADE rule rewrites management traffic and breaks HSM management ports. current nftables example in the quickstart is too generic.

Sam: paste the minimal repro so we can add a callout in the checklist.

Maya: repro: 
```bash
# problematic iptables rule (example)
iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -o eth0 -j SNAT --to-source $PUBLIC_IP
```
This rewrites container/local mgmt connections. Workarounds: scope the --source, use MASQUERADE for ephemeral clouds, or explicitly accept/connmark mgmt ports.

Liam: let's add an explicit HSM firewall snippet + nftables example and a short callout in KMS docs: "If you run HSM on single-NIC hosts, ensure mgmt IPs/ports are excluded from SNAT."

Ashley: agree. i'll add a bullet in the installer checklist; do you want a separate PR for the HSM policy snippet or include in #4207?

Maya: include in #4207 if small — I already updated install-playbook and private/vpc quickstart. left a TODO where the snippet belongs: https://redwood.internal/docs/pr/4207

docs-bot: Link checker: found broken link -> private/onprem/kms (404). Please fix before merge. :robot_face:

Sam: which anchor changed? I can patch the crosslink.

Maya: the "Key management" anchor moved after the refactor. I updated the target but missed the installer crosslink. will push a follow-up commit.

Liam: also add a short migration note for Dedicated customers moving to single-NIC: "When switching topologies, review HSM mgmt IPs and NAT rules; see troubleshooting."

Ashley: tiny style nit — put ports in code font (e.g., `8700`) and prefer concrete commands. makes copy/paste easier.

Maya: plan: (1) fix anchor + broken link, (2) add nftables + iptables snippets and SNAT exception, (3) add migration callout. i'll ping when pushed.

Sam: i'll do a final review after commits. :thumbsup:

Maya: pushed commit 2: link fixes + nftables snippet. PR: https://redwood.internal/docs/pr/4207

Ashley: LGTM on the visible changes; suppressed one lint warning for generated ports table.

docs-bot: CI: docs lint passed; linkcheck running. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Liam: request: include an explicit connmark/nft example to accept mgmt ports before SNAT, e.g.
```bash
nft add rule nat postrouting tcp dport {8700,8743} counter accept
```
short and actionable.

Maya: added that line in KMS troubleshooting subsection.

Sam: thanks. will merge once linkcheck clears.
